hypothesis: H3: our illumination reproduces the LROC WAC map over its own year, r >= 0.85 (pre-registered)
reference: WAC_POLE_ILL_TWI_SOUTH_100M v1.3 (LROC, Speyerer & Robinson 2013), 100 m/px, 88-90 S

registration.what: r between the WAC map and NASA's LOLA AVGVISIB at the sample points, per axis orientation (independent of SUNLOCK)

namedSites.note: a single 60 m crest pixel in NASA's LOLA map (40-55% within 120 m around it); WAC's 100 m, photo-registered pixels cannot resolve it, so this point is not counted against either map

secondary.what: sensitivity only, not pre-registered: points with WAC >= 5% (scattered light inflates near-zero WAC values)

deviations: Named sites: only current sites inside the WAC map's 88-90 S coverage can be compared; they are listed individually (namedSites) and not pooled into r, since two or three points would not change it and would mix a curated set into a random sample.
Horizon reach: the adopted converged convention uses 150 km (decided after H1, documented in validate-lola.mjs); the shipped convention keeps the pre-registered 64 km.
